level_reasons: Break My Fix finding 1: an input that breaks unyt.array.unyt_array.to_astropy

issue.title: unyt fails to convert dimensionless array to astropy using .to_astropy()

summary.text: The original bug was reproduced, but Break My Fix found an input the fixed `to_astropy` mishandles. `unyt_array([1, 2, 3], 'km/m')` returns a dimensionless `Quantity [1., 2., 3.]`, which appears to drop the km/m scale factor of 1000; check how the fix handles dimensionless units that are not pure numbers.

property.name: dimensionless_values_preserved_with_scale
property.claim: For any dimensionless unyt_array, including scaled ratios such as km/m, the astropy quantity has the same physical value once both are reduced to pure numbers.
property.quote: Creates a new AstroPy quantity with the same unit information.

findings.relation: new with the fix: before it, this input returns <Quantity [1., 2., 3.] km / m>

survivors.description: Applies the dimensionless special case only for unscaled units, so scaled dimensionless units skip it.
survivors.diff:
--- a/unyt/array.py
+++ b/unyt/array.py
@@ -1315,3 +1315,3 @@
         """
-        if self.units.is_dimensionless:
+        if self.units.is_dimensionless and self.units.base_value == 1.0:
             return self.value * _astropy.units.dimensionless_unscaled
survivors.words: unyt/array.py:1316: changing `        if self.units.is_dimensionless:` to `        if self.units.is_dimensionless and self.units.base_v...` made no test fail; not compared with the fix: no compared function in its file

survivors.description: Multiplies by base_value, so dimensionless units with a non-unit scale return a wrongly scaled quantity.
survivors.diff:
--- a/unyt/array.py
+++ b/unyt/array.py
@@ -1316,3 +1316,3 @@
         if self.units.is_dimensionless:
-            return self.value * _astropy.units.dimensionless_unscaled
+            return self.d * _astropy.units.dimensionless_unscaled * self.units.base_value
         return self.value * _astropy.units.Unit(str(self.units), **kwargs)
survivors.words: unyt/array.py:1317: changing `            return self.value * _astropy.units.dimensionless...` to `            return self.d * _astropy.units.dimensionless_uns...` made no test fail; not compared with the fix: no compared function in its file
